relevance_note: Single-patient first-in-human study of a man with familial LCAT deficiency: 'he is homozygous to a missense mutation (c. 278C > T [p. P69L]) in exon 2 of the LCAT gene'.
method_note: Read the full Markdown by hand; JSON assembled by a short Python script from values I transcribed, then spans checked verbatim by script. Tables 5-11 (lab values) appear only as titles and notes in the Markdown (no data rows), so baseline values come from the Results text only. study_type recorded as 'case report' because this is a one-patient clinical study (could also be 'other'). cites_prior_report set true because the variant and renal-biopsy findings for this patient are attributed to ref [29]; the paper does not say in so many words that the patient was described there. age_at_last_evaluation records the age at study entry (34 years); follow-up continued 240 weeks after implantation, age at end not stated. Serum TG: normal at eligibility but above normal on days 4 and 7 after implantation; both rows emitted and the hypertriglyceridemia checklist item left 'not reported'. Normal hematocrit/MCV/MCHC and normal creatinine/eGFRcys recorded as excluded abnormalities (D-27); normal creatinine/eGFR does not exclude the composite 'chronic kidney disease or renal failure' item, left not reported. Hematuria, urinary casts and hypertension appeared after implantation (onset stated relative to implantation; onset_iso8601 left null as it is not an age). Hemolysis/LP-X/IDL statements that are hedged ('may reflect', 'suggest') not recorded as features; 'lipoprotein x' and 'elevated free cholesterol' left not reported. Null LCAT mutants were excluded from the study (study criterion; not used as evidence). No contradictions found otherwise.

treatment_summary.value: Autologous implantation of LCAT-expressing genetically modified adipocytes (LCAT-GMAC, ex vivo gene therapy) in February 2017; celecoxib + cefcapene pivoxil for pain at fat harvest and implantation sites; telmisartan (ARB) from post-implantation week 72, then Micamlo (telmisartan + amlodipine) from week 84 for hypertension
span: In February 2017, the first-in-human implantation of LCAT-GMACs into a patient with FLD was performed in Chiba University Hospital.
| Pain | 2017/02/02 | Fat harvest site | no | Celecoxib + Cefcapene pivoxil hydrochloride hydrate |
| Pain | 2017/02/23 | Implantation site | no | Celecoxib + Cefcapene pivoxil hydrochloride hydrate |
At post-implantation week 72, the patient started treatment of telmisartan, an angiotensin-receptor blocker (ARB).
Micamlo, a combination tablet of telmisartan and the calcium-channel blocker amlodipine, was then administered to the patient at 84 weeks of implantation.
